test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: If 12 January 2004 is Monday, then what will be the day of the week on 26 February 2011?
solution:
Given : 12 January 2004 was Monday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 12 January 2004 to 26 February 2011 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 2004
 12 January 2004 - 31 December 2004
 366 - 12 day of Jan = 354 days 
 354 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 2005 - 2010
 Full years (5 Ordinary years + 1 Leap years)
 (1 odd day × 5 Ordinary years) + (2 odd days × 1 Leap years) = 7 odd days
 7 ÷ 7 = 0
 
 

 2011
 1st January 2011 - 26 February 2011
 31 January + 26 February = 190 days 
 57 ÷ 7 = 1
 
 

 Total odd days
 **5**&
